record.what_it_does: LinkedIn Marketing/Advertising API for managing ad accounts, campaigns, creatives, targeting and reporting.
record.auth_notes: 3-legged OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow only (scopes such as rw_ads, r_ads, r_ads_reporting). Docs state 2-legged client credentials is not available for marketing use cases. Member must hold an ad account role.
record.access_notes: Free to apply, but the app must be approved for the Advertising API product. Development tier: read on unlimited accounts, edit on up to 5 mapped ad accounts. Standard tier (unlimited edit, needed for a public multi-user product) requires a support ticket, and LinkedIn may decline. Audience Insights and Media Planning are restricted. I did not open the application form, so review timelines are unconfirmed.
record.api_breadth_notes: Rest.li-style REST under api.linkedin.com/rest, versioned monthly. Covers ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, targeting facets, audience counts, budget pricing, analytics/reporting, lead sync, conversions, matched audiences, and boosts. Community Management is a separate product. Operation count was not tallied, but it is well over 50.
record.mcp_notes: No LinkedIn-published MCP server found. Community or third-party options include the PyPI package linkedin-ads-mcp (which states it is unofficial), AdKit, AdPlug, Two Minute Reports, the npm package mcp-linkedin-ads, and CData.
record.blocker_notes: The app needs Advertising API approval. Development tier limits edits to 5 ad accounts, and Standard tier needs a manual support-ticket upgrade at LinkedIn's discretion before arbitrary users can connect for write operations. Read access is unlimited in the Development tier.

evidence.quote: All these permission scopes are 3-legged permissions requiring explicit consent from a LinkedIn member. The 2-legged client credentials flow is not available for any marketing use cases.
Development tier is designed to build end-to-end workflows and supports read-only access for unlimited ad accounts and edit capabilities for up to five (5) Ad Accounts.
The Standard API Access must be requested via a support ticket to be submitted on the Developer Support Portal.
LinkedIn reserves the right to review applications and select partners at its discretion and a partner might not be upgraded even if they meet these minimum requirements.
Webhook for Social Actions: - Push notifications disabled
An Ad Account (a.k.a. Sponsored Account) is an umbrella entity for advertising management on LinkedIn, e.g., billing, campaigns, ad creatives, tracking tags, and more.
Access to Advertising API is a mandatory requirement for applying to Matched Audiences API, Audience Insights API and Media Planning API.

record.needs_human: Confirm the Advertising API application and review turnaround, since I did not open the apply form. Confirm the webhook coverage. The only webhook evidence I saw was for Community Management social actions. LinkedIn has some lead-gen and other notifications, but I did not verify them. Confirm whether an OpenAPI spec exists. The test-ad-account sandbox claim is based on the Development tier allowing creation of 1 test Ad Account through the API. No separate sandbox environment was seen. The MCP finding comes from search results only.
